Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|ja|大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65258929|lt=Ōtori Faith}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|arz|ياماتو تاكيرو|be|Ямата Такэру|de|Yamatotakeru|es|Yamato Takeru|fa|یاماتو تاکه‌رو|fr|Yamato Takeru|hu|Jamatotakeru|id|Yamato Takeru|it|Yamato Takeru|ja|ヤマトタケル|ko|야마토타케루|pt|Yamato Takeru|ru|Ямато Такэру|sh|Yamato Takeru|simple|Yamato Takeru|sq|Jamato Takeru|sr|Јамато Такеру|sv|Yamato Takeru|tr|Yamato Takeru|uk|Ямато Такеру|ur|یاماتو تاکیرو|vi|Yamato Takeru|zh|日本武尊|zh_min_nan|Yamato Takeru|qid=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}.
As a {{ill|religious corporation|ja|宗教法人|qid=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.
